note: West, TX -- all ten districts in the 'Schedule of District Regulations', Section 20 of the City of West Zoning Ordinance (Exhibit 14A to Chapter 14 of the West Code of Ordinances). ROUTE: read directly from the city's published codification on eCode360 at the citation_url (General Code's eCode360 product carries the City of West's own Code of Ordinances and Exhibit 14A as attachments). The page returns the schedule as an HTML table and rendered cell text, not as a JavaScript shell, so the read is reproducible from a plain fetch of that URL. No Municode, mirror or PDF route was needed; the city's own ordinance list page (cityofwest.com/city-ordinances) links the same code. VINTAGE: Section 20's own foot reads '(Ordinance 210406 adopted 4/6/2021)', read at source. Section 27 (Repealer, Severability, Engrossment and Enrollment Clause) is printed in the same document and this table assumes the Ordinance 210406 text is the version in force; no later amending ordinance appears in the codified Exhibit 14A as read. WHAT THIS SCHEDULE DOES NOT GIVE: (1) No lot-coverage column exists at all -- Section 20 regulates 'Maximum Impervious Cover' instead. max_lot_coverage_pct is therefore a not_specified sentinel for all ten rows and max_impervious_pct carries the real figure; do not read the impervious figure as a building-footprint cap, they are different metrics. (2) The schedule states no corner-lot side yard: its own note defers corner lots, street-adjacency and more-restrictive-adjacency to the ordinance text. side_corner_ft is a not_specified sentinel for all ten rows. (3) MF's front yard cell reads 'Variable', and C-2's and M-1's rear and side yard cells read 'Depends on Bldg. Ht.' -- none of those is a scalar, so they are coded as sentinels with the cell quoted. (4) MH-1's side yard cell reads 'Min. 14 ft. between units' and MH-2's reads '14 Ft./7 Ft.' -- unit separation, not a lot-line setback, and the MH-2 cell is not self-describing; both are coded as flagged non-scalars at the stated figure. (5) AG and SF-E take their district-level yard rules from the ordinance text (Sections 9 and 10) in addition to this schedule; only the schedule cells are coded here. Height: every height cell states stories AND feet ('2.5 stories/36 Ft.'), so max_height_ft is a stated feet figure for all ten rows, not a stories conversion. AG's '3 stories/45 Ft.', M-1's '3 stories/45 Ft.' and MF's '3 stories/45 Ft.' are the tallest.
